text:
### Escalation If Identity Cannot Be Verified
- Don't process change
- Request additional verification
- Escalate to manager if customer disputes
- Document reason for refusal
- Contact customer with next steps  
---
name: Chunk 10/52

raw_entities.name: Change of Address with Identity Verification Escalation
raw_entities.description: A change of address procedure that includes identity verification as a mandatory gate. When identity cannot be verified, the process escalates to a manager for dispute resolution, with documented refusal reasons and customer notification of next steps.
context: Escalation If Identity Cannot Be Verified
Escalate to manager if customer disputes

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification for Address Change
raw_entities.description: A verification step that validates the customer's identity before processing an address change. This step acts as a compliance gate and determines whether the address change can proceed.
context: Escalation If Identity Cannot Be Verified

raw_entities.name: Request Additional Verification
raw_entities.description: When initial identity verification fails, the process requires collection of additional verification documents or information from the customer to support the address change request.

raw_entities.name: Manager Escalation for Disputed Verification
raw_entities.description: If the customer disputes the identity verification failure, the case is escalated to a manager for review and resolution. This step provides a dispute resolution pathway.
context: Escalate to manager if customer disputes

raw_entities.name: Document Refusal Reason
raw_entities.description: A mandatory recording step that documents the specific reason why the address change was refused due to failed identity verification. This creates an audit trail for compliance purposes.

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification of Refusal and Next Steps
raw_entities.description: The customer is contacted with notification of the address change refusal and informed of the next steps available to them, including options for dispute or resubmission.

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification Pass/Fail Gate
raw_entities.description: A compliance gate that determines whether the customer's identity has been successfully verified. If verification fails, the address change is not processed and additional verification is requested.
context: Escalation If Identity Cannot Be Verified

raw_entities.name: Manager (Address Change Dispute Resolution)
raw_entities.description: A manager responsible for reviewing and resolving disputes when a customer contests the identity verification failure in an address change request. This role has authority to escalate or override the initial verification decision.
context: Escalate to manager if customer disputes

raw_entities.name: Verification Officer (Address Change)
raw_entities.description: The operations staff member responsible for performing the initial identity verification check and requesting additional verification documents when the first attempt fails.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification for Change of Address
raw_entities.description: The address update process that is subject to identity verification before being processed. The new address cannot be recorded until identity verification is successfully completed.
context: Escalation If Identity Cannot Be Verified

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification Compliance Gate for Address Change
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance checkpoint that verifies customer identity before an address change is processed. This gate ensures that address updates are only made to verified account holders, protecting against unauthorized account modifications.
context: Escalation If Identity Cannot Be Verified
